payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details on how LDA and Gibbs sampling are utilized to evaluate ISWC and WWW publications, including the extraction of data and the application of these methods in the analysis.

claims.text: LDA and Gibbs sampling were applied to evaluate ISWC and WWW conference publications from 2013-2017, focusing on discovering topic trends and relationships between LDA topics and paper features.
Gibbs sampling was used to estimate and infer parameters of LDA, facilitating the analysis of the publications' abstracts and titles.
